name: Historical figures
about: Famous people no longer with us, from ancient history to recent.

details.Cleopatra: Last pharaoh of Egypt, seduced Caesar and Mark Antony
details.Julius Caesar: Roman general and dictator, stabbed in the Senate
details.Leonardo da Vinci: Painted the Mona Lisa, sketched helicopters centuries early
details.Marie Curie: Discovered radium, first person to win two Nobel Prizes
details.Isaac Newton: Worked out gravity and the laws of motion
details.William Shakespeare: Wrote Hamlet, Romeo and Juliet and Macbeth
details.Napoleon Bonaparte: French emperor who conquered most of Europe
details.Abraham Lincoln: US president who ended slavery, assassinated at the theatre
details.Nelson Mandela: Spent 27 years in prison, became South Africa's president
US civil rights leader, "I Have a Dream"
details.Mahatma Gandhi: Led India to independence through non-violent protest
details.Winston Churchill: British PM who led the UK through World War II
details.Frida Kahlo: Mexican painter famous for bold self-portraits
details.Vincent van Gogh: Painted Starry Night, cut off part of his own ear
details.Socrates: Greek philosopher sentenced to death by drinking hemlock
details.Aristotle: Greek philosopher who tutored Alexander the Great
details.Confucius: Chinese philosopher whose sayings shaped East Asia
details.Genghis Khan: Founded the Mongol Empire, the largest land empire ever
details.Alexander the Great: Conquered from Greece to India before age 32
details.Joan of Arc: French teenage warrior, burned at the stake at 19
details.Queen Elizabeth I: The Virgin Queen, beat the Spanish Armada
details.Henry VIII: English king with six wives, beheaded two of them
details.Nikola Tesla: Inventor behind AC electricity, rival of Edison
details.Charles Darwin: Came up with evolution by natural selection
details.Galileo Galilei: Astronomer put on trial for saying Earth orbits the Sun
details.Ada Lovelace: Wrote the first computer program in the 1840s
details.Amelia Earhart: First woman to fly solo across the Atlantic, vanished in 1937
details.Harriet Tubman: Escaped slavery and led others to freedom
details.Frederick Douglass: Escaped slave who became a famous speaker and writer
details.Oscar Wilde: Irish writer and wit, jailed for being gay
details.Mark Twain: Wrote Tom Sawyer and Huckleberry Finn
details.Ernest Hemingway: Novelist, big-game hunter and heavy drinker
details.Muhammad Ali: Heavyweight boxing champ, "float like a butterfly"
details.Marilyn Monroe: Hollywood's biggest sex symbol of the 1950s
details.Freddie Mercury: Queen's frontman, one of rock's greatest voices
details.John Lennon: Beatles founder, shot in New York in 1980
details.Elvis Presley: The King of Rock and Roll
details.Benjamin Franklin: US founding father who flew a kite in a storm
details.Ned Kelly: Australian bushranger in homemade armour, hanged in 1880
details.Rasputin: Russian mystic who was poisoned, shot and drowned
details.Marco Polo: Venetian who travelled to China in the 1200s
details.Harry Houdini: Escape artist who could get out of anything
details.Hunter S. Thompson: Gonzo journalist, wrote Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas
details.Anthony Bourdain: Chef and TV host who ate his way around the world
details.Sun Tzu: Chinese general who wrote The Art of War
details.Hannibal Barca: Crossed the Alps with elephants to attack Rome
details.Attila the Hun: Feared warlord who terrorised the Roman Empire
details.Charlemagne: King who united much of Western Europe around 800 AD
details.Saladin: Sultan who took back Jerusalem from the Crusaders
details.Captain James Cook: British explorer who mapped Australia's east coast
details.Blackbeard: Notorious pirate who lit fuses in his beard
details.Queen Victoria: Ruled Britain for 63 years, the Victorian era
details.Marie Antoinette: French queen beheaded in the Revolution
details.Alexander Hamilton: US founding father, killed in a duel, star of the musical
details.Simón Bolívar: Freed much of South America from Spanish rule
details.Florence Nightingale: Founder of modern nursing, "the Lady with the Lamp"
details.Edgar Allan Poe: Master of horror, wrote The Raven
details.Charles Dickens: Wrote Oliver Twist and A Christmas Carol
details.Leo Tolstoy: Russian novelist, wrote War and Peace
details.Michelangelo: Painted the Sistine Chapel ceiling, carved David
details.Coco Chanel: French fashion icon, the little black dress
details.Thomas Edison: Inventor of the light bulb and phonograph
details.Carl Sagan: Astronomer who made space exciting on TV
details.Neil Armstrong: First person to walk on the Moon
details.John F. Kennedy: US president assassinated in Dallas in 1963
details.Rosa Parks: Refused to give up her bus seat, sparked a movement
details.Bruce Lee: Martial arts legend and movie star
details.Jimi Hendrix: Greatest rock guitarist ever, set his guitar on fire
details.Janis Joplin: Raspy-voiced rock and blues singer of the '60s
details.Steve Jobs: Co-founder of Apple, launched the iPhone
details.Robin Williams: Comedy genius from Mrs. Doubtfire and Aladdin
details.Tutankhamun: Boy pharaoh whose tomb was found full of gold
details.Boudica: Celtic warrior queen who burned London
details.Spartacus: Gladiator who led a slave revolt against Rome
details.Niccolò Machiavelli: Wrote The Prince, the rulebook for ruthless leaders
